description:
The U.S. Army Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Fires is issuing a Common Autonomous Multi-Domain Launcher (CAML) Munitions Pallet (MP) Prototyping and Integration Request for Solutions Brief (RFSB) with intent of awarding one or more Other Transaction Agreements for Prototype (OTAP) IAW 10 U.S.C. § 4022. Only U.S. companies with the ability to process and store SECRET information and hardware are eligible to submit a solutions brief.

Please refer to attached Request for Solutions Brief (RFSB) document for additional information.

Please be aware of separate RFSB response dates for the Tomahawk MP variant and the other MP variants.
